name: Echo runnable examples added
instruction: A TaskFlow progress comment for the Echo agent-harness build task.

content.body: Added runnable developer examples and pushed them to GitHub. Main commit e291e21 adds examples/curl/README.md, examples/python/simple_client.py, examples/python/observer_external.py, a safe fake Codex rollout fixture, README updates, and tests/test_examples.py. Verification: wrote failing tests first; uv run pytest tests/test_examples.py -> 2 passed; uv run pytest -> 49 passed; observer_external.py successfully wrote a fake Codex transcript into a watched temp root and the service observed the external session/messages through watchfiles and HTTP; simple_client.py created a session/run/message through the live API. Repo: https://github.com/tijszwinkels/agent-harness-echo
